RequestEnvelope.description: Transport envelope only. Command arguments and hub identity remain semantic dispatch checks during incremental migration. Extensions remain accepted for v1 compatibility.

FailurePolicy.description: Local client guidance, not a server receipt or proof of rollback. Unknown errors are conservative; no mutation is automatically retried.

TailUserId.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal, checked semantically without conversion through a JS number.

RemoteHost.description: Local operator registration, not a peer claim. Worker implementation and capabilities must occur together; client-only registrations omit both.

RemoteRegistry.description: Explicit pinned authority for one hub. Semantic validation rejects duplicate machine/node IDs, missing roles and noncanonical capabilities. Not network enrollment.

RemoteCheckSnapshot.description: Read-only local registration check. Neither a transport connection nor native-effect or client readiness evidence.

RemoteWorkerHello.description: A claim on an already peer-verified connection; never proof of identity. connectionId must match a fresh hub-issued challenge.

NativePath.description: Decoded UTF-8 byte limit and NUL refusal are additional semantic checks; paths are not a sandbox.

NativeArguments.description: Typed decoding view only. Each operation additionally requires its exact argument schema; never normalize this view for request hashing.

NativeRequest.description: Private local-worker v1 request. Safe Pi IDs, high-half ephemeral IDs, progress identities, operation-specific args and embedded Rex plans are semantic checks. Hash original bytes, not typed re-encoding.

NativeResult.description: Compatible bounded native result projection. Optional metadata remains optional for retained results; unknown well-formed failure codes never establish absence or replay permission.

NativeResponse.description: Exactly one result/progress payload, matching the original request ID and operation, is required semantically without adding a new v1 discriminant.

NativeReceipt.description: Validation view of existing retained receipt bytes; never rewrite or normalize historical receipts through this codec.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Closed v1 success/error variants. Payload semantics and exact request-ID correlation are additional boundary checks; an error never proves a mutation did not execute.

PiId.description: Lossless decimal Pi identity. Positive safe-integer range remains an additional semantic guard; never coerce a numeric JSON ID to a string.

DurableRequestId.description: Durable mutation identity, distinct from transport correlation. Existing runtime UTF-16 length limits remain semantic checks during migration.

CommandString.description: Nonempty well-formed wire string. Existing UTF-16 limits, nonblank text, absolute cwd and saved host authority remain semantic checks.

StatusBinding.description: Read-only saved metadata projection; empty/offline bindings are not current worker authority. Older peers may omit display metadata.

StatusModel.description: Compatible Pi model reference, not a new persisted settings format. Provider-specific parameters stay opaque.

StatusInspection.description: Bounded outer Pi inspection view, NOT selected-chat ActivitySnapshot. Opaque Pi records/extensions are retained and never used as client lifecycle authority.

StatusSnapshot.description: Startup/selection identity. Optional capabilities are not inferred when missing on older peers; current producers emit all capabilities and implementation.

LoginId.description: Opaque transient login/prompt identity. Legacy 200000 UTF-16-unit input limit remains semantic; not a durable mutation ID.

AdmitArgs.description: Legacy v1 extensions remain accepted but are not forwarded to Pi; origin cannot be supplied through this command.

CreateTaskArgs.description: Legacy v1 extensions remain accepted but are not forwarded to conversation creation.

AdmitAck.description: Durable submission only, not generation or effect completion.

CreateTaskAck.description: Created/retrieved conversation only, not inference or terminal allocation.

InstructionImportAck.description: Administrative task admitted, not instructions applied. Echoed chat/request identities must additionally match the original request.

ListChatsArgs.description: Canonical conversation scan, not a lifecycle/health catalog. Legacy request extensions remain ignored. Omitted limit defaults to 50; after is the exclusive last-scanned Pi ID.

ChatListLabel.description: Well-formed display metadata only, not host/path authority or a command argument. No trimming/normalization of canonical metadata.

ChatListItem.description: Read-only canonical metadata projection. Optional link IDs are display hints, never Pi ownership authority. Unknown/private fields refuse at the wire boundary.

ChatListPage.description: Bounded scan projection, not a frozen snapshot. Items may be empty with a next cursor when scanned records lack Deck metadata. ID safety, ordering, requested limit, link pairing and last-scanned cursor consistency remain semantic checks.

LiveViewArgs.description: Read-only activity/progress selection; omitted chat defaults to main. Activity may opt into the bounded Pi agent-status observation. Legacy ignored extensions remain accepted.

AgentStatus.description: Read-only Pi work observation. Done/error require the latest settled generation task ID. Working may carry its latest settled reply's generation ID to baseline unread indications while other work drains. Not a worker-health or future-idleness guarantee.

ActivitySnapshot.description: Bounded presentation sampled from Pi, not a lifecycle/worker-health or process-draining receipt. Existing UTF-16 label caps remain semantic guards.

ProgressSnapshot.description: Replaceable provisional sample, not an append stream or effect receipt. Generation/tools require a run ID; UTF-16 text caps remain semantic guards.

InstructionSourceView.description: Bounded labels/provenance, never instruction text. Absolute cwd, safe task ID and UTF-16 caps remain semantic checks.

InstructionTaskView.description: Outcome/result consistency and applied-source identity are semantic checks, not live state authority.

InstructionSnapshot.description: Current source and historical import task are separate samples; an applied task does not prove its source is still current.

HistoryAfter.description: Exclusive entry cursor; only the literal zero or a canonical positive safe Pi ID is accepted semantically.

HistoryArgs.description: Legacy ignored extensions remain accepted. before/after are mutually exclusive; after zero bootstraps an empty chat. Limit defaults to 100.

HistoryInputData.description: Fields consumed by the plain renderer, not the whole Pi/input archive schema. Original capture and extension bytes are not rewritten.

HistoryContentPart.description: Unknown content types remain opaque and unrendered. Text/toolCall required-field checks are semantic, selected by type.

HistoryMessage.description: Compatible view of rendered message fields; provider metadata, reasoning and tool arguments remain opaque and are not rendered.

HistoryEntry.description: Existing v1 numeric entry IDs are preserved, unlike string cursors. Pi-owned record extensions and unknown kinds remain untouched; known rendered kinds receive additional generated payload checks.

HistoryPage.description: Closed bounded page. Next must equal the final entry ID in scan order, never an empty-page cursor. Attached live views use generated closed contracts and request-scoped semantic validation; they remain separately sampled observations.

StopArgs.description: Selected-chat stop request. Legacy ignored extensions remain accepted; no durable request or cancellation-completion receipt is created.

StopAck.description: The stop was requested, not proof Pi is idle, effects drained or rolled back.

RexStartupArgs.description: Historical registration only. Explicit matching envelope hubId, original ownerless allocation intent and saved worker/cwd remain semantic requirements.

RexStartupAck.description: Historical startup ACK, not the broader read-only startup snapshot, live presence, allocation proof or input-delivery receipt. Echoed identities and explicit expected hub require separate checks.

RexTargetOptions.description: Optional first-open overrides. Omitted fields resolve on the assigned native worker; saved targets are reused on subsequent opens.

RexAllocationPlan.description: Native allocation input. Absolute paths, UTF-8 byte limits, socket syntax, assigned-worker authority and executable identity are additional semantic checks.

RexCreation.description: Retained creation evidence, not readiness. Unknown fields remain accepted for legacy compatibility but are never copied into the public binding.

RexAllocationReceiptQuery.description: Read-only lookup of exactly the original allocation request bytes; never dispatch that request.

RexAllocationReceipt.description: Historical native receipt evidence, not a fresh Rex observation or permission to replay.

TuiRequest.description: Client-only renderer bridge, never a Pi execution channel. One outstanding request; no replay on loss.

TuiDraft.description: Display-only preview. Retry always uses the original DraftStore request, never this preview.

TuiTasks.description: One bounded discovery page; labels are display-only, never routing authority.

TuiRex.description: Selected-chat creation provenance and optional independent presence sample, not agent health.
